title: OXO Good Grips Everyday Glass Food Scale 11lbs/5kg
description:
About this item
Zero function for taring the scale before weighing additional ingredients
Digital screen with large, easy-to-read numbers
Unit conversion button to measure in ounces, pounds, gram or kilogram
Glass platform resists stains and wipes clean
Four AAA batteries included
reviews_5s:
I absolutely love the OXO Good Grips Glass Food Scale! It's sleek, accurate, and incredibly easy to use. The glass surface not only looks great in my kitchen but is also super easy to clean. The large, easy-to-read digital display makes weighing ingredients a breeze, and I love that it has a tare function, which ensures precise measurements every time.

The scale is highly sensitive and accurate, even for small amounts, which is essential when following recipes. It’s also compact and stores easily without taking up much space. Whether I'm measuring flour, liquids, or small ingredients, this scale has been an indispensable tool in my cooking and baking routine.

The OXO Good Grips design makes it comfortable to handle, and the overall build feels very durable. I highly recommend this scale for anyone who values precision in the kitchen. It’s definitely a worthwhile investment!So happy that I found this kitchen scale. 1) Just the right size...easily fits in my kitchen drawer 2) Glass surface is very attractive. Numbers are bright, large and easy to see. 3) Easy to tare, change units and power off and on, simply by touching glass. No buttons that will eventually wear out and fail. 4) Good price and value. 5) Only drawback is that the capacity is limited to 11 pounds, but that won't be a concern for most home cooks.First let me start off by saying that this is a great scale and is accurate! Fits a few different size and style containers on it with no problems reading. The minor things that make the experience not perfect comes down to the buttons. It's nice looking and I'm sure conforms to usability on having the "buttons" just be spots on the top glass surface, but man does it make you unsure of if you've pressed it or not sometimes. Especially the power button having more than one function. If you want to zero your scale it's a quick press, with a slightly longer than comfortable pause before it zeros. But if you want to turn the unit off it's a long press, which leaves you thinking if you've actually turned it off or not. I've actually thought I've turned the scale off and walked away to do something else in the cooking process only to look back and see my scale still lit up. It's easy enough to just go and turn it off, but I'm unsure if it has an auto shutoff (you'd think it would). But these are really just minor minor annoyances, not something that would really make me not like the scale or anything. Also they included 4 AAA batteries, which is a nice touch. I still give it 5 stars, just wish it could get an A+!A good scale with precision to 1 g. Precise enough for cookingPerfect scale for everyday kitchen use.

It has a variety of weight modes (oz, g, etc), and it has an actual "ZERO" mode. It even has liquid measurement. It makes weighing out baking ingredients a breeze. Pro tip: If you like to bake or cook, use weight. Don't use cups, tablespoon, etc.

It cleans easy with a quick wipe, and it turns off when not in use.

The only gripe I have about it is that I accidentally turn it on when putting it away. The buttons are kinda sensitive, but I guess that's a good thing.We bought the earlier OXO scale possibly 10 years ago, and it was a valued item in our kitchen. It finally stopped working, so we bought this item as a replacement.

This iteration seems to be better in every way. Easier to use, easier to clean and additional useful features. One of the features we like is the ability to weigh items in the same units a recipe uses. No more looking for a calculator and trying to find some conversion factors.Never used a food scale before but I started baking and love the zero out feature that lets me measure by gram/other weight instead of using measuring cups.
Only complaint is that it seems finicky to turn off. Sometimes it will take a long press (5 seconds) to turn off and other times it will stay on despite the 5 second press on the power button.
Like all the various weight options though: grams, ounces, pounds/ounces, mL (although I am not sure how to measure that - thought that was a volume).
Would recommend if you are looking for a pretty basic inexpensive scale.I knew this would be a little small, but I do not have the anticipated problem with it being small.Nice size, easy to clean. Good price for the quality , brightness and durability.I love the look of this - flat top so easy to clean. Great range and works well. Love it!
reviews_1s:
Keep scrolling to another product. This one is a disaster. I have had mine 17 months. It is unreliable, inefficient and downright annoying. Simple tasks like turning it on and off are terrible. It is inaccurate and fluctuates as you use it. It cannot even stay at zero or r close to zero as you use it and you basically have to keep taring it over and over leaving you to wonder how accurate it is. Probably not very accurate at all. I just butchered a whole ribeye like I do every Easter and I have decided I have had enough of this piece of garbage. Do not buy this.This is what I wrote to Oxo and it says it all: I purchased the OXO Good Grips Everyday Glass Food Scale 11lbs/5kg on Amazon on December 4, 2024. This was to replace the original purchase where the units kept on changing on the scale without touching the unit "button." This "new" Oxo scale is even worse than the first and the return to Amazon is past the 30 days. I did want Oxo to know how terrible this item is and how it fails to function as it is supposed to giving incorrect and varied weights causing me to weigh and reweigh the same item. I promise because of this experience not to purchase this item again or in fact any other Oxo item and will include this message on my Amazon review. In all fairness to Oxo they are replacing the scale with one of greater value and reliability. I am grateful that Oxo stands by their product.I bought this scale in April, 2024, and used it exclusively for measuring ingredients while baking. It lasted less than 8 months before failing. I noticed it being a bit off in early November, but thought perhaps I wasn't being careful. While measuring flour for bread, I verified the quantity with a different digital scale; the flour was over by 85g - which is substantial in bread baking. I do NOT recommend this scale.Click to play video
This is the second Oxo scale that I've received after the first one that I ordered from Amazon gave me similar issues (Amazon was unwilling to refund me because the return date has passed by one day, but that's another story).

I requested a replacement with Oxo directly and they sent this to me. The same plastic cup that we use to measure our coffee beans would change in 'weight' anywhere from 4-8g (as shown in the video attached to this review). As anyone who makes their own coffee knows, a 4g difference can be quite significant when pulling a shot! This happens almost every morning, so I'm requesting a refund from Oxo directly but will be looking into another scale option since this one doesn't seem able to do it's job.This is super easy to clean but I would NEVER buy it again. You have to tap the buttons 3-8 times to get them to respond, and they are super slow. Most of the time it turns off trying to get it to tare. It also has weird measurement unit options that just create more stuff to attempt to click through. TERRIBLE scale.OXO usually has superior designs. This is not one of them. It might be OK if you only weigh items over 6 lbs (?)

It doesn’t show tenths of grams so it’s useless for coffee. The tare button is not responsive enough. It should have a USB charger.

I bought a far superior scale for $10 less.Corner of glass shattered within a month of purchase. It probably did get bumped, but only in usual kitchen use. I have other glass scales that have been fine for over a decade. Very disappointed in durability. No idea when the glass chipped off either, and what food it may be in.Not sure how this has such high ratings. It's extremely inaccurate.Bought this in January 2023. It started being inaccurate this month, October 2024. I wish this lasted longer. I will buy another brand next time.I had a digital kitchen scale made by Oxo before. That one had a pull-out display and physical buttons, but it was hard to keep clean. I thought this would be a good replacement.

When weighing in anything larger than a very small bowl, it is difficult to impossible to see the display. Additionally, because the controls are capacitive, if there's a little food or water on the surface, good luck zeroing the scale, changing the units, or turning it off. Attractive product, but the design is not very usable.
